You activated Nightmare Mode, monsters will be much stronger and you can't save nor teleport away from them, however, items found will be much stronger.

source:
Intellect represents a character's ability to reason and understand complex, abstract concepts.
Spell Damage and Spell Critical Damage are based on Intellect.
translation:
지능은 복잡하고 추상적인 개념을 추론하고 이해하는 능력을 나타냅니다.
주문 피해와 주문 치명타 피해는 지능을 기반으로 합니다.
sample_context: local baseText="Intellect represents a character's ability to reason and understand complex, abstract concepts.\nSpell Damage and Spell Critical Damage are based on Intellect."

source: Personality represents both a character's strength of will and personal charm. Maximum spell points, Mana cost and Healing Power are based on Personality.
translation: 인격은 의지력과 개인적인 매력을 모두 나타냅니다. 최대 주문력, 마나 비용, 회복 위력은 인격을 기반으로 합니다.
sample_context: local baseText="Personality represents both a character's strength of will and personal charm. Maximum spell points, Mana cost and Healing Power are based on Personality."

source: Welcome to the arena, warriors! This might be different than you remember. Prepare yourselves, sharpen your skills, and brace for the challenge ahead. Get ready to showcase your strength, strategy, and determination. The battle awaits!
translation: 전사들이여, 투기장에 온 것을 환영합니다! 기억하던 모습과는 다를 수 있습니다. 각오를 다지고 기술을 연마해 눈앞의 도전에 대비하십시오. 힘과 전략, 의지를 증명할 준비를 하십시오. 전투가 기다립니다!
sample_context: Text = "Welcome to the arena, warriors! This might be different than you remember. Prepare yourselves, sharpen your skills, and brace for the challenge ahead. Get ready to showcase your strength, strategy, and determination. The battle awaits!"
